_note: REQ-L10N-010: English of the texts the C# client (Muchi.Client) and the Unity game layer (unity/Assets/Muchi/Game) build, keyed by the exact Japanese they render. {placeholders} make templates (number-like names match numbers only; {hm} = 4:00; {n:ord} in the English = 3rd). Composite texts fall back to sentences (。) and list parts (・ 、 ＋ ' / '). Server texts are not here (server-en.json, generated). GameChecks L10nChecks and engine CommentaryLocaleTests check coverage. Same wording rules as the server: no multipliers, no fake urgency.
